scope: Whole-catalog inventory, all RU source URL checks, structural/translation parity; targeted primary-source fact checking and editorial revisions. Not a sentence-by-sentence legal re-verification of every guide.
method: 3,303 distinct source URLs in the combined RU catalog checked with HTTP HEAD; all 237 HTTP 404/410 results retried with GET.
A reachable URL is not evidence that all guide claims are accurate. Access-denied/timeouts are unconfirmed, not dead.
Only fully rewritten/new guides receive a new lastVerified date. Partial amendments retain the previous full-review date.
Existing IDs and premium/pinned flags preserved. Similar topics were retained to avoid breaking bookmarks; exact-title candidates are listed for a later consolidation review.
